'''Wakamiya Shrine''' (若宮神社, Wakamiya Jinja) refers to various {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrines|1=Shinto shrine}} located across Japan.
Most notably [[Wakamiya Shrine (Shimonoseki)]]
